scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.deploy: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production pnpm build && wrangler d1 migrations apply sunsal --remote --env production && cd apps/web && wrangler deploy --config dist/sunsal/wrangler.json
scripts.db:seed:local: node packages/data/scripts/to-sql.ts packages/data/data/sample-complexes.json > .wrangler/sample.sql && wrangler d1 execute sunsal --local --file .wrangler/sample.sql
